About.title: About GenoLabGab
About.missionText: GenoLabGab is an independent initiative dedicated to bioinformatic analysis and genomic interpretation of tropical infectious diseases. Founded on the conviction that genomics can transform epidemiological surveillance and clinical management, our work aims to make accessible the expertise needed to understand, monitor, and anticipate the evolution of emerging and drug-resistant pathogens.
About.focusTitle: We focus on three major public health challenges:

focus.tb: Tuberculosis: detection of multidrug-resistant (MDR-TB) and extensively drug-resistant (XDR-TB) strains, monitoring of high-risk lineages (Beijing, CAS)
focus.malaria: Malaria: surveillance of artemisinin and partner drug resistance, characterization of Plasmodium falciparum genetic diversity
focus.amr: Antibiotic resistance: identification of acquired resistance genes and chromosomal mutations in priority bacteria (ESKAPE)

About.founderText: An engineer by training with self-developed expertise in bioinformatics, Karl MOUNGUELE K. combines a deep understanding of molecular biology with mastery of modern genomic analysis pipelines. His career has led him to work on high-throughput sequencing projects, metagenomics, and variant analysis, with a particular focus on public health applications.

skills.sequencing: Sequencing: Illumina (short-read), raw data analysis (FASTQ, BAM, VCF)
skills.bioinformatics: Bioinformatics: reproducible pipelines (Nextflow, Snakemake), containerization (Docker, Singularity)
skills.genomics: Genomics: de novo assembly, reference alignment, variant calling, functional annotation
skills.stats: Statistics: omics data analysis, hypothesis testing, scientific visualization
skills.programming: Programming: Bash, Python, R, biological database integration

About.rigorText: Every analysis follows strict reproducibility standards:

rigorPoints.code: Open source code: all pipelines are documented and versioned
rigorPoints.containers: Containerization: isolated environments to guarantee cross-platform reproducibility
rigorPoints.validation: Validation: systematic confrontation of genomic predictions with available phenotypic data
rigorPoints.traceability: Traceability: complete recording of parameters and tool versions used

monitoringPoints.mutations: Newly validated resistance mutations (WHO databases, CARD, MalariaGEN)
monitoringPoints.tools: Emerging bioinformatic tools and best practices

applicationsPoints.surveillance: Epidemiological surveillance: early identification of resistance hotspots, monitoring of high-risk clone spread
applicationsPoints.precision: Precision medicine: genome-based predictive antibiogram, therapeutic decision support
applicationsPoints.research: Translational research: characterization of emerging resistance mechanisms, validation of new molecular targets

About.independenceText: GenoLabGab operates independently, free from commercial conflicts of interest. Our analyses rely solely on validated scientific data and open source tools maintained by the community.
About.transparencyText: We believe in open science. Our methods, results, and limitations are documented without omission. We systematically cite sources and databases used.
About.impactText: Every report we produce aims at a concrete objective: informing a clinical decision, guiding public health policy, or advancing understanding of a biological mechanism. We don't do genomics for genomics' sake.
About.collaborationsText: GenoLabGab is open to collaborations with:

collaborationsPoints.research: Research laboratories: universities, public health institutes, infectious disease research centers
collaborationsPoints.hospitals: Hospitals and clinics: clinical strain analysis, genomic result interpretation support
collaborationsPoints.publicHealth: Public health organizations: epidemiological surveillance, bioinformatics training
collaborationsPoints.international: International projects: genomics consortia, One Health initiatives
